notes:
- Feature: new strategy TRIGGER 7 - Instant single-trigger (client text "Quotex bot spec: instant single-trigger entries", verbatim in docs/CLIENT-STRATEGY-TEXTS.md; line-by-line rules in docs/TRIGGER7-SPEC.md). Seven triggers checked on every tick (not at candle close), any one fires a trade: T1 Bollinger touch, T2 RSI extreme 25/75, T3 EMA 9/21 cross, T4 EMA20 pullback with EMA20 vs EMA50, T5 within 0.05% of a swing level from the last 50 15 m candles, T6 engulfing or pin bar, T7 momentum (3 ticks or candles, 5 to 15 s). Indicators are kept incrementally (O(1) per tick). CALL and PUT on the same tick = skip; one open trade per account; no second entry on the same candle; expiry 1 candle (setting). Risk: 1% stake (up to a 2% cap), no martingale, 30 min pause after 3 of its own losses in a row, stop for the day at -5%, optional +5% profit stop, no trades 15 min around high-impact news. Win rate per trigger over its last 100 trades, a trigger below 54% switches itself off. Per-trigger ON/OFF and timeframe (5 s to 5 m, incl. 2 m and 3 m), all numbers in Settings, trade CSV with the logged fields and signal-to-click / signal-to-confirmation times. All triggers default to 15 s so the Quotex Time box never has to change before a click.
- 2 m and 3 m candles are now built for every pair (needed for TRIGGER 7's timeframe choice).
